invariants: Neither function connects, reads the environment, or performs any I/O.
Each group provides exactly one binding and holds exactly one factory - nothing optional survives the freeze.
responsibilities: register_worker validates the config effect-free, then wraps PgSessionFactory in a PreparedGroup providing "pg-worker-session" and requiring nothing.
register_reconciler is the same shape, providing "pg-reconciler-session".
RegistrationError from PreparedGroup::new maps into AdapterError through the From impl in error.rs.
summary: The crate's staging entry points: one register function per role, each returning a PreparedGroup with exactly one session factory. No I/O at staging.
